text:
Jordan: Hey team — need quick sync on PO+signature path for Acme POC. They want a signed orderform + MSA/DPA. Two asks: 1) Can we accept a PO with net45? 2) They need countersign on our DPA redlines. Also will attach SOC2 report.
Maria: @jordan we don't accept net45 by default for POC credits. Who's the contact? :thinking:
Jordan: Contact is elena@acme, procurement lead. They said finance needs an invoice instead of prepay for POC.
Tina_finance: @jordan we can do invoice for pilot if sales pre-approves credit terms. Need tax ID and billing entity on orderform. Also need PO number on invoice.
Nisha_se: On the MSA redlines — they want to add a 45-day SLA credit. Our standard is 7-day cure + service credits per Dedicated pricing. Any legal take?
Lee_legal: @nisha_se share the exact clause they propose. We're usually ok to add SLA credits for Dedicated but POC hosted API rarely. Also DPA: don't accept broad subprocessor carveouts. Send redline pdf.
Jordan: Sending redline now — attaching link: https://files.redwood/incoming/acme_dpa_redline.pdf
Lee_legal: Got it. Quick notes: 1) Remove perpetual liability cap removal; 2) Countersignature path accepted (DocuSign ok). If they need wet-ink, escalate.
Maria: For signature routing — they require CISO signoff on DPA and procurement sign on orderform. Who is CISO contact?
Nisha_se: CISO is doing a quick security questionnaire. They asked about KMS/HSM and data residency. We have SOC2 + optional KMS addendum.
Jordan: I told them KMS is supported via Private deployments, we can include KMS addendum for enterprise. For hosted POC, we can add SOC2 attachment and restrict access.
Tina_finance: Also note: if they issue PO after signed orderform, invoice must reference orderform id. We need billing address and remittance instructions. Can sales collect?
Jordan: I'll get billing address + PO#. @elena can you provide tax ID and billing address? Also confirm signer for procurement (name/email) and CISO contact.
Elena (Acme): Hi Jordan — we can provide PO and tax ID. CISO is peter@acme-security. Procurement signer is monica@acme-finance. We prefer DocuSign.
Lee_legal: DocuSign is fine. We'll prep a countersigned DPA with tracked changes and minimal edits. Please route to legal@redwood for countersign.
Maria: Small flag — they requested a 90-day data retention window change in DPA. Legal: stay firm on 30 days unless Dedicated/private. @jordan confirm.
Lee_legal: Confirmed. Offer 30 days for hosted POC; for Dedicated we can negotiate extended retention with controls.
Jordan: Noted. I'll confirm with Acme and collect PO. Also asking for procurement to put 'PO for POC only' on the PO.
Tina_finance: Once PO arrives, send to invoices@redwood with orderform id. Finance will review and pre-approve net45 for pilot case-by-case.
Nisha_se: I'll send the KMS addendum template and SOC2 link to peter@acme-security.
Jordan: Thanks all — action items: collect PO + tax ID (Jordan), send DPA redline to legal (Jordan), legal to prepare countersign (Lee), finance to pre-approve net45 after PO (Tina), SE to send KMS docs (Nisha). Ping here when done.
Lee_legal: A couple follow-ups: if they ask for indemnity expansion, escalate to counsel. Otherwise this looks routine.
Jordan: Will do. tagging @maria when PO lands. :thumbsup:
Deploy-bot: Document uploaded: acme/orderforms/1732100001-orderform.pdf
Maria: Received PO and PO# ACME-2023-112. Jordan, please forward to invoices@redwood and cc legal.
Jordan: Forwarded. Invoices receipt confirmed by finance. Closing loop once countersigned DPA is back.
Elena (Acme): We see signed orderform in DocuSign, awaiting your countersign on DPA.
Lee_legal: Countersigned DPA sent via DocuSign to elena@acme. SLA credit language left as redlined but we agreed to keep host POC limits.
Jordan: All set — orderform signed, DPA countersigned, PO in. Moving to onboarding. Thanks team :party_parrot:
